title: Data Quality Engineer-Azure Data Platform Testing
description:
Data Quality Engineer – Azure Data Platform Testing
  
  
**Overview**
Seeking a seasoned Azure Data Engineer Tester to drive test strategy and ensure data quality across a large-scale Azure data platform modernization initiative. Data is a critical enterprise asset, and this role ensures accurate ingestion, transformation, storage, and reporting across cloud-based data solutions. The ideal candidate has test lead experience, strong automation skills, Agile exposure, and familiarity with P&C insurance domains.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test Strategy & Leadership
  
  

* Drive overall test strategy and create effective test cases and scenarios based on business and user requirements
* Define and implement test automation strategy, ensuring the right balance of manual and automated testing
* Participate in architecture, design, requirements, and code reviews; provide feedback to stakeholders

Azure Data Pipeline Testing
  
  

* Test Azure data pipelines built using services such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Synapse Analytics
* Validate end-to-end data movement from source to destination across batch and streaming workflows

Ensure Data Quality & Accuracy
  
  

* Validate ETL/ELT transformations across Medallion architecture layers
* Identify missing, duplicate, or incorrect data and ensure business rules are applied accurately
* Validate analytical outputs such as dashboards, reports, and data visualizations

Database & Storage Validation
  
  

* Test data stored in Azure SQL Database and Azure Data Lake Storage for integrity, reliability, and performance
* Validate schema, source-to-target mappings, and data models

Automation & Performance Testing
  
  

* Develop automated test scripts using SQL, Python, and PySpark
* Perform performance, scalability, and load testing of pipelines and data platforms
* Track defects and test cycles using Jira

**Desired Skills & Competencies**
Data & Technical Acumen
  
  

* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, star schemas, data marts, and Medallion architecture
* Ability to read data models and update source-to-target mapping documents
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Azure, DBT, Python, and PySpark

Industry & Methodology
  
  

* Experience working in Agile environments
* Knowledge of Property & Casualty (P&C) and Specialty Insurance is preferred

title: Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network Design, LAN/WAN, RFP )
description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
Architect and design the solution to meet the business requirements of SITA customers predominantly in the pre-sales phase (RFPs or unsolicited opportunities) with focus on deployment, infrastructure, network architecture, and cloud architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Manage technical solution in response to an RFP or unsolicited case that can consist of multiple SITA products (and portfolios), which includes new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios.
* Design the deployment architecture and infrastructure specifications- servers and networking(LAN and WAN) for a solution to the customer’s requirements.
* Design deployment architecture for SITA products, including runtime environment in various flavours – on premise servers, virtualized server environment, containerized application environment through Kubernetes, public cloud, etc., to meet functional and non-functional system requirements.
* Design the network solution – both LAN/WLAN (in the airport) and WAN.
* Develop the conceptual design, and high-level design, and provide suitable inputs for the low-level design.
* Develop Bill of Materials:
* Compute & Storage and Networking.
* Specifications for - Servers, Virtual Machines, Containers (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), etc. based on guidance from SITA's product toolkits.
* Storage - including backup solution
* Networking – LAN/WLAN components including switches, firewalls, etc. and WAN components including telco circuits, and also SD-WAN.
* Software Licensing requirements – Operating System, Database, Virtualization, etc.
* Other Infrastructure – Power (UPS), Racks, Cabling, etc.
* Guides and contributes to the design coordination and development solutions working with multiple parties both internally and externally.
* Contributes to the transfer of projects for implementation.
* Interact with colleagues to gain knowledge and to share ideas.

**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and/or Engineering.
* 7- 10 years of experience in Information Technology, Air Transport, Telecom, or any other relevant industry in a technical Pre-Sales role
* Proven track record in producing communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions
* Proven track record in managing solution proposals, costing, and customer presentation with great level of details.
* Expert in Network design WAN/Campus LAN, Cisco SDA, WLC, ISE, ACI, Nexus or similar technologies
* Solid experience in designing compute, storage, and networking solutions in all possible deployment scenarios – on premise, virtualized environment, private cloud, public cloud, or a mix.
* Solid experience in Security: IPSEC, Access-lists, NAT, understanding of Firewall functions
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity such as Azure Express Route, AWS Direct Connect, is a great plus
* Understanding of Cloud Security such as Zscaler, Cisco umbrella is a great plus
* Understanding of Systems Monitoring – Network Monitoring, Security Monitoring (SIEM), etc.
* Understanding of Versa (or Cisco) SDWAN architecture, Salesforce and Service Now is a great plus
* Adept at drawing technical diagrams - good knowledge of Visio, competence in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Network design and standard vendor products
* Server sizing (virtualized environment and cloud) and software licensing
* Commercial Acumen

**What We Offer**
SITA’s workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:
  
  
🏡
**Flex-week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your Team's needs).
  
  
⌚
**Flex-day:**
You may wish to flex your arrival time at the office, to beat the rush hours or you may want to leave the office earlier to pick up your kids from school or to go to your favorite game: We support you in being open about your needs and routine with you manager.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-location:**
Benefit for 30 working days from anywhere around the world each year!
  
  
🙌🏽
**Competitive benefits**
according to the local market
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process*

title: Solutions Architect - Public Sector
description:
FEQ427R107
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you will shape the future of the Data & AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. You will be a technical advisor internally to the sales team, and work with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field. You will help our customers to achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the use of our Databricks Lakehouse Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise Ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in big data, analytics, data engineering and data science problems
  
  
Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic prospects and customers, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
  
  
This is a Hybrid role, based in Delhi.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
* You will work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications
* Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre-sales/consulting role
* 8+ years of experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others
* Strong consulting / customer facing experience , working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
* Coding experience in Python, R, Java, Apache Spark™ or Scala
* Experience building distributed data systems
* Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Available to travel to customers in your region
* Nice to have: Databricks Certification

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Application & Cloud Security Lead
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
  
  
This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
* Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
* Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
* Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
* Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
* Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CCSK, Cloud Vendor Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security — Specialty, AWS Certified Solution Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent credentials.

title: Experienced Architect
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
Join Ericsson as an Experienced Architect for CBEV Biller TPG, focused on Invoicing (INV) and Finance (FIN). Bring senior Java engineering and software architecture expertise to a business-critical telecom BSS product. You will translate business and product needs into robust, secure, scalable software designs; guide teams from specification through implementation and verification; and help evolve Biller capabilities for production-grade operator environments. Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and responsible AI-native software development are expected parts of the engineering approach.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own and evolve CBEV Biller architecture, especially INV and FIN; translate business needs and non-functional requirements into solution designs, service boundaries, interfaces, data models, and architecture decisions.
* Design modular distributed services and BSS integrations using APIs and messaging; address availability, scalability, performance, security, resilience, data consistency, observability, and operational support.
* Provide hands-on Java leadership: guide implementation, review code and designs, solve complex issues, improve quality, and coach engineers.
* Promote automated testing, secure development, clean code, CI/CD, performance analysis, and production readiness; manage technical risks and debt.
* Drive Spec-Driven Development (SDD), linking requirements and specifications to design, code, tests, and acceptance evidence. Use approved AI coding tools and agents with effective prompts and human review, protecting security, privacy, and code integrity.
* Guide invoice flows including bill cycles and runs, periodic and on-demand billing, invoice generation and formatting, charges, taxes, discounts, enquiries, and corrections.
* Guide finance flows including customer accounts and receivables, invoice/payment posting, payment allocation, balances, adjustments, deposits, refunds, reversals, transfers, write-offs, reconciliation, and accounting export.
* Protect financial correctness, auditability, and data integrity through robust transaction handling, retries, recovery, and reconciliation; collaborate across product, development, verification, and operations teams.

**What You Will Bring**

* 10 to 15 years of hands-on Java development, with demonstrated technical leadership and architecture responsibility appropriate to an experienced architect role.
* Strong Java and object-oriented design: advanced language concepts, concurrency, patterns, debugging, profiling, performance, and secure coding.
* Experience with Spring/Spring Boot, microservices, REST/SOAP, Hibernate or similar persistence, and data modelling.
* Ability to design distributed systems, APIs, and synchronous/asynchronous integrations; experience with cloud-native delivery, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and GitOps.
* Quality-first mindset with Java test automation and unit, integration, and end-to-end testing experience.
* Practical experience with generative AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot or Claude), AI agents, and prompt engineering; familiarity with SDD workflows and documentation.
* Strong BSS and telecom billing knowledge, with depth in both Invoicing and Finance. CBEV/BEAM or comparable BSS, billing, and accounting integrations are an advantage.
* Kafka, Cassandra, and full-stack troubleshooting across UI, services, and APIs are beneficial. Bring clear communication, ownership, mentoring, Agile collaboration, and a relevant degree or equivalent experience.

**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**
**Why join Ericsson?**
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Principal, Tech (Middleware)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a senior technologist to join our Messaging Middleware team based in the firm’s offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurugram. The team is responsible for building and evolving a framework for real-time data streaming web applications used across the firm. This framework enables partner teams to focus on business logic while relying on a robust shared platform to handle the complexity of real-time messaging, data delivery, scalability, resiliency, observability, and developer ergonomics. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will help shape the technical direction of a core platform, make key architectural and implementation decisions, contribute directly to high-impact systems, and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, mentorship, and example.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will design, build, and enhance a framework that powers real-time data streaming web applications across the firm. You will work on capabilities that improve platform efficiency, robustness, scalability, observability, and ease of use for application teams. You will partner closely with framework users to understand their requirements and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that support low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant application behavior. You will drive performance tuning across the stack, including messaging, serialization, transport, concurrency, backpressure handling, and client/server interactions. You will help design resilient systems that handle failures gracefully, including network interruptions, traffic spikes, and partial service degradation. You will also contribute directly to the implementation of critical components, review architecture and code, troubleshoot production issues, and drive improvements in testing, operability, and long-term design health. As a senior technical leader on the team, you will mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration. You will influence engineering culture by setting a high bar in technical rigor, ownership, and execution, and periodically providing clear updates to senior stakeholders on technical direction, system health, key deliverables, and important risks or trade-offs.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and object-oriented programming
* The candidate should have 7+ years of software engineering experience building high-performance, real-time distributed systems
* The candidate should have strong experience with messaging middleware, event-driven systems, and low-latency data streaming architectures
* Proven experience designing and building production-grade frameworks, platforms, or shared infrastructure
* The candidate should have strong understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed systems
* The candidate should have hands-on experience with technologies such as Kafka, Solace, NATS, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, WebSockets, SSE, or gRPC streaming
* The candidate should have strong software design, debugging, testing, and code quality fundamentals
* The candidate should have experience with production observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support
* The candidate should have demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience as a senior individual contributor
* The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication skills
* The candidate should be comfortable working in a language-agnostic environment
* Candidates with experience in browser-facing real-time applications, serialization and wire protocols, resilience patterns, or large-scale performance testing will have an added advantage

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplMiddlewareApr26

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description: DescriptionAmazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.Key job responsibilitiesAs an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellencePreferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience with very large distributed systems Knowledge of design process Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, RustOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, driving adoption, business value realization, platform optimization, and long-term success. Experience with customer community platforms such as Sprinklr Community or similar solutions is highly desirable and will be considered an advantage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end managed services delivery, ensuring platform stability, governance, adoption, and alignment with customer business objectives.
* Drive strategic consulting engagements, helping customers optimise digital experiences, engagement models, operational processes, and platform utilisation.
* Act as the primary advisor to customer stakeholders, providing guidance on best practices, platform capabilities, governance frameworks, and roadmap planning.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution design, enhancement planning, and execution of continuous improvement programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks covering user administration, access management, workflows, content lifecycle management, and operational controls.
* Oversee platform health checks, audits, release management activities, and optimisation reviews.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience challenges.
* Own reporting, analytics, adoption measurement, and recommendations to improve customer outcomes.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams supporting managed services engagements.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Provide architectural guidance on integrations, APIs, authentication, SSO, enterprise connectivity, and ecosystem solutions.
* Establish reusable delivery standards, governance playbooks, operational frameworks, and best practice models.
* Contribute to customer digital transformation initiatives, ensuring scalable and sustainable platform adoption.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and customer-facing managed services engagements.
* Strong consulting experience involving solution design, customer advisory services, governance reviews, and stakeholder management.
* Expertise in platform governance, operational excellence, adoption strategies, user management, workflows, and business process optimisation.
* Strong understanding of user experience principles, digital engagement strategies, information architecture, and customer journey optimisation.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and modern digital experiences.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, integrations, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience facilitating workshops, executive reviews, solution discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer management skills.
* Experience leading distributed delivery teams and managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer-to-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.
* Experience with customer communities and digital engagement platforms is considered a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realisation.
* Well-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**

Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**

Sutra.AI is a complete ‘Data to Value’ AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose-built for mid-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.

**The role**

You own how the platform is built. You are the hands-on technical lead for the core platform and the data layer that every product runs on. You set the architecture, write and review the critical code, and hold the bar on quality, security and scale. You take over day-to-day platform and data architecture from the CTO.

Engineers across the platform look to you for technical direction, design review and code review.

Stack you should be familiar with

* **Data:**
  open lakehouse (Trino, Apache Iceberg), change data capture, data quality monitoring
* **Ingestion:**
  AI-assisted connectors for ERP, SQL databases, files and SaaS sources
* **AI:**
  leading LLMs on AWS and GCP, agents and tool-calling (MCP), vector search
* **Apps and services:**
  Python, FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Postgres
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM tracing and evals, product analytics
* **Cloud:**
  AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Compliance:**
  SOC 2, HIPAA-ready deployments

**What you will own**

* **Core platform architecture:**
  security, scalability, multi-tenancy, connector standards, extension points.
* **Data access and performance:**
  a governed data access layer that serves interactive apps with fast response times alongside heavy AI agent workloads, with cost and latency under control.
* **Interfaces between teams:**
  clear, written contracts between platform components so product teams build on the platform, not around it.
* **Code quality:**
  review standards, design reviews, hands-on review of critical paths. Raise the bar for the whole team.
* **Security and compliance by design:**
  least privilege, fine-grained data access controls that AI cannot bypass, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit trails. Turn compliance requirements into architecture, not paperwork.
* **Reliability:**
  SLOs, observability, on-call design, self-healing pipelines, and scaling as customer usage grows.
* **Technical direction**
  for data engineers and full stack engineers.

**Must have**

* 8+ years building backend and data platforms, with recent hands-on coding. You still ship.
* Built production data pipelines and platform infrastructure: lakehouse or distributed query engines (Trino, Spark, Iceberg, Delta or similar), CDC and ingestion, data quality.
* Strong distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Security-first: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit. Experience in a SOC 2, HIPAA or similarly regulated environment.
* Hands-on AI exposure: shipped LLM or agent features in production, and understand evals, tool-calling and MCP well enough to design platforms for them.
* Has made architecture decisions at scale and lived with the consequences.
* Leads through design and code review. People want your review.

**Nice to have**

* Query engine internals, catalog performance, query planning
* OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS and GCP
* Enterprise system integration (ERP and other line-of-business systems)
* Healthcare, defense or financial compliance programs

**This role is not**

A people manager. A pure DevOps or SRE role.

**How we hire**

* Intro with the CTO
* Architecture deep dive: walk us through a platform you designed, including what you would change
* Live design: a governed data access layer for a multi-tenant AI platform
* Code review exercise
* Final with CEO

**What you get**

Ownership of the platform every product runs on, direct work with the CTO, real enterprise data problems, and meaningful equity.

title: Application Architect
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build high-performance, stateless REST APIs using asynchronous and event-driven patterns for high-volume, low-latency interactions.
* Design decoupled microservices communicating through message queues, event buses, or streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Pulsar.
* Architect systems for high concurrency, large payloads, pagination, and version-safe message exchange using Protobuf, Avro, or JSON.
* Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes or ECS, applying Docker containerization, CI/CD automation, observability, and autoscaling.
* Design storage and caching strategies using PostgreSQL, Aurora, MySQL, Redis, Memcached, RocksDB, or DynamoDB, balancing latency, durability, and cost.
* Build backend services using Go or Rust, with Python for orchestration and automation; apply functional, concurrency, and idempotency principles.
* Develop load-testing and benchmarking approaches using Locust, k6, or JMeter; profile systems and optimize CPU, memory, I/O, and garbage collection.
* Establish design standards that improve resilience, observability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Create automated unit, integration, and black-box testing for asynchronous flows, schema conformance, and payload validation.
* Own API lifecycle and contract management, including backward compatibility, schema versioning,

pagination, partial updates, and modular validation
  
  
**Qualifications And Experience**

* 8 – 11 years of experience designing, building, and operating distributed, asynchronous systems and production-grade applications.
* Strong expertise in REST, gRPC, microservices, message-driven systems, and event-driven architectures.
* Hands-on proficiency in Go, Rust, and/or Python, with experience deploying microservices on Kubernetes or ECS.
* Strong experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, DynamoDB, or comparable low-latency storage and caching technologies.
* Working knowledge of Locust, k6, or JMeter, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
* Strong understanding of Docker, CI/CD, DevOps practices, Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools, and functional, reactive, and concurrent programming.

description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

****In This Role, You Will:****

* solving complex platform challenges,
* partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent’s customers, and
* executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption

In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale.
  
  
****In This Role, You Will:****

* Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments.
* Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability.
* Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis.
* Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges.
* Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving.
* Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution.

****How You Will Spend Your Time****
This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is:
  
  

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*
