title: Sr. Cloud Engineer
description:
**Senior Cloud Engineer**
Gurugram, Haryana, India
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer that delivers, operates and continuously improves Azure IaaS/PaaS and Private Cloud platform components that support Azure PaaS, OpenPaaS, MPI and POD. Act as a hands‑on technical contributor and trusted implementer who applies established architecture patterns, automates platform delivery, and supports projects to ensure secure, resilient and cost‑efficient production services.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Implement architecture: Translate HLDs into LLDs and implement approved designs for VMs, networking, storage, security and OpenShift components under guidance from platform leads.
* Infrastructure as Code: Develop, test and maintain production‑grade IaC (Terraform, ARM, Harness) and contribute to reusable modules and templates.
* Automation & CI/CD integration: Integrate platform components with CI/CD pipelines, support Harness/Artifactory workflows and automate routine provisioning and deployments.
* Platform validation: Test PaaS services and platform features, produce runbooks and provide readiness feedback to platform owners.
* Operational support: Monitor platform health, troubleshoot incidents, participate in on‑call rotations as required and support DR and recovery activities.
* Platform enablement: Deliver foundation modules (app skeletons, baseline configurations), assist projects with resource provisioning and fulfil OpenShift and firewall requests.
* Collaboration: Work closely with IaaS/PaaS leads, Automation, DevOps, Network and Security teams to resolve platform defects and implement improvements.
* Cost, security and compliance: Apply FinOps practices, enforce security and policy controls in deployments, and support audit remediation tasks owned by the Cloud Platforms team.
* Continuous improvement: Contribute to platform roadmaps, propose optimizations, and help industrialize successful POCs into production patterns.
* Knowledge sharing: Document solutions, run design reviews, and mentor more junior engineers when appropriate.

You will report to Head of Cloud Platforms.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Cloud platforms: Solid hands‑on experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS and PaaS; familiarity with Private Cloud concepts.
* Containers & orchestration: Practical experience with Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes and Docker.
* IaC & automation: Proficient with Terraform and/or ARM; experience with CPP, Harness or similar automation tools.
* CI/CD & tooling: Experience integrating services into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Harness).
* Scripting & config: Comfortable with YAML and scripting (Bash, Python) for automation and tooling.
* Observability: Working knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalents).
* Networking & security: Experience with Azure networking, firewalls (Azure FW), OCP egress and identity/secrets management.
* Development mindset: Developer‑focused approach to platform enablement and automation.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Relevant years of experience in cloud/platform engineering with demonstrable Azure and OpenShift experience.
* Education & certifications: Degree in Computer Science or equivalent; Azure and OpenShift certifications are a plus.
* Methodologies: Comfortable working in Agile/Kanban teams and iterative delivery models.
* Language: Fluent in written and spoken English.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.

Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. **Required Skills & Experiences**

* Design and deliver software solutions for utility customers.
* Translate product requirements and regulatory changes into concrete technical designs, implementation plans, and actionable engineering tasks.

* You have a exemplary knowledge of governance, security, compliance, and data and privacy considerations is essential. Proven experience optimizing complex, high-throughput systems for performance and cost efficiency is expected
* You have demonstrated the ability to lead and mentor development teams, set architectural direction, and align cross-functional stakeholders on technical trade-offs and delivery priorities.
* You're also a technical leader who can mentor engineers, guide design decisions, and influence cross-functional stakeholders across product, platform, and AI teams. You will be part of the Industry AI unit for Energy and Natural Resources, a team focused on turning Industry AI opportunities in the ENR space into measurable customer value.
  
  
In this role, you’ll help raise engineering standards beyond your immediate responsibility by spearheading architectural best practices, fostering an AI-powered development culture, and enabling your team to deliver with confidence and momentum.

Key competencies in this role include agentic engineering, agentic orchestration, AI-assisted engineering, cloud architecture, cloud security architecture, CI/CD, evaluation and benchmark engineering, scalability design, semantic retrieval, systems thinking, and technical executive team. title: Principal Engineer
description:
****About Payoneer****
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Principal Engineer – Backend
  
  
****About Payoneer****
Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.
  
  
The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.
* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.
* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.
* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.
* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.
* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.
* Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.
* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.
* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.
* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

****What We're Looking For****

* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.
* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows.
* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.
* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment.

****What Success Looks Like****
In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.
* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.
* Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.

* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, FinTech Tax

Amazon is seeking a rock star Software Development Engineer who will own, architect and shape the future of our FinTech Tax Technology with capabilities to process withholding taxes applicable on invoices and making related payments, provide financial data integration and process global tax requirements across Amazon.
  
  
Can you work at the scale of the biggest Internet companies?
  
  
The solutions that you will build must scale to accommodate rapid processing and integration with large enterprise customers. However, to add to the challenge, the solutions must also support integration with highly scaled systems.
  
  
Are you ready to create best in class taxation systems to expand one of the world’s largest e-commerce engines?
  
  
If so, come be a member of Amazon’s FinTech Tax Technology team. FinTech Tax Tech builds software systems that ensure compliance for Amazon's global businesses and its subsidiaries and makes it easy for millions of Amazon vendors including publishers, app developers, game developers, marketplace sellers, associates and others to comply for hundreds of billions of dollars in transactions. The software platform is among the largest in the world by volume and complexity handling billions of dollars of payments. Much of our work enables Amazon’s new market or business model launches and happens as part of these enterprise programs. We partner integrally with the CFO organization worldwide, including the central finance functions and line of business leadership. We're constantly looking for opportunities to expand capabilities in new geographies and new lines of business.
  
  
Is your next project defining a world class Internet service?
  
  
With us, you will be architecting and delivering applications and services in an environment of highly distributed systems used by Amazon Tax teams. Your innovation will provide new functionality for millions of vendors/payees/sellers globally with a goal of making it easy to comply with tax regulations. You shift your experiences from working at the peripheries of the systems to actually start designing their cores.
  
  
Do you want to define the future of Internet commerce?
  
  
Are you a top-notch software engineer with a creative flare, strong problem-solving skills, the drive to build and ship products often, a solid computer science foundation, and the desire to build Amazon's next generation financial systems architecture to enable 100+ Amazon businesses across Retail, AWS, Physical Stores, Corporates and many more? Come talk with us about joining our customer obsessed team as we expand our capabilities in new geographies and newer lines of business.
  
  
Are you up for overcoming challenges in an highly entrepreneurial environment?
  
  
Enabling Amazon’s explosive growth requires top talent in our FinTech Tax Technology organization. We are seeking Sr. Software Development Engineers who will drive next generation architectural and design choices, invent new features, develop distributed services, keep financial data secure, and build a scalable, service-oriented and performance oriented platform for our customers.
  
  
A successful candidate will be a role model to set an example for building strong and highly-effective teams you can trust, provide direction and guidance to other engineers in the team while you own the critical path of the architecture, work collaboratively with your customers, and deliver extensible, scalable, resilient, serverless, and secure architecture. As you charter unchartered areas, you embrace ambiguity to innovate with bold bets to drive business growth through technology. You continually solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context aligning your team’s work, goals and priorities with Amazon’s business objectives. You will build flexible systems and processes without over-engineering and choose simple, straightforward solutions over more complex ones.
  
  
We are seeking someone who has passion for learning, excellent in communication and out-of-box thinker with a can-do attitude and a focus on delivering high quality software. We move at a fast pace and deliver software iteratively using agile best practices and the latest technologies.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

title: Cloud FinOps Team Lead
description:
**Cloud FinOps Team Leader**
Gurugram, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL Global Technology (GT) division has been going through significant transformation including simplification of applications landscape across geographies and business units, Cloud transformation and migration to strategic platforms, as well as operating model transformation to support upcoming technological and business process changes. These include setting modernized standards, new technologies, increased level of automation and new ways of working. Now, as part of Cloud BAU, Cloud FinOps main goal is to ensure that AXA XL’s Cloud spend is well understood, governed and managed. Head of Cloud FinOps is a crucial role in the organization, with primary responsibility to manage Cloud cost optimization, rightsizing strategies, and resource allocation, aiming for efficient and cost-effective business processes. They play a vital role in financial planning and analysis, monitoring and communicating key performance indicators for management to make data-driven decisions, oversee and guide the FinOps team, ensuring seamless collaboration with other teams such as application development, architecture, financial accounting, and management.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Continue to develop and implement FinOps best practice frameworks, including policies, processes, and best practices, to ensure effective cloud financial management aligned with organizational goals. Collaborate with architects, application delivery, cloud engineers, DevOps, finance, and procurement teams to enhance integration of FinOps principles and promoting responsible cloud usage, through education and best practice processes.
* Create financial dashboards, provide insights and forecasts to senior stakeholders, and foster a culture of cloud financial responsibility through training. Manage Azure cloud service budgets, participate in CSP negotiations via Procurement, and conduct regular FinOps maturity assessments to drive continuous improvement.
* Report on accuracy, policy compliance and leading initiatives to enhance cloud financial management in line with industry best practices and assigned budget. Build and implement data-driven reporting allowing to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimizing resources, and tracking utilization for efficiency. Provide regular, timely, transparent and accurate cloud consumption costing information to management team and recommendations for optimization.
* Outline, communicate and foster chapter ownership and governance across teams (application development, architecture, finance, management, business) to optimize synergies and encourage joint goals. Assist building of the FinOps community within application teams to increase maturity and ensure they have the Fin Ops knowledge they need to be responsible for their own costs.
* Maintain AXA XL Cloud run costs that forecasts are maintained for the Global IT estate over the financial period and that we can achieve run rate savings, this includes:
* Periodic production of cloud costs to consumption owners to ensure trends are understood and anomalies addressed
* Maintaining average cost profiles of applications migrating to cloud and then updating cloud cost forecasts in line with migrations
* Assist with yearly budget process to ensure budget requests are in line with the business case forecasts
* Active membership of AXA Group’s FinOps community to gain from and share learnings with the community. Also produce quarterly reporting required by Group.
* Maintain a good understanding of the cloud provider pricing models so that can work with Application Teams to give recommendations on potential cost savings. Work with technical teams to drive technical optimizations such as right sizing.
* Calculate cloud costs and set budgets for applications as part of the project processes, once live then monitor actual spend against the budget. Manage project recharge process where applicable, or raise alerts if applications spend higher than agreed budget.
* Reconciliation of monthly invoicing to our CSP usage and ensure that service credits are given where applicable and that we are tracking against committed spend.
* Implement the budget and alert framework for any threshold spikes or anomalies to take preventative action if necessary.

You will report to Head of Cloud Platforms.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Certified FinOps professional with preferably finance background and experience. E.g. FinOps Certified Practitioner, Cost Management & Finance Qualifications.
* Proven ability in conducting and presenting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating the results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations to various audiences (technical teams, finance teams, senior management).
* Excellent financial and analytical skills with ideally good experience in Cloud Service Consumption Modelling tools in a large-scale IT infrastructure and application environment.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and leadership skills, with a track record of presenting to senior management. Excellent cross department and cross Group collaboration skills.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a track record of developing business relationships that can drive change.
* Good understanding of Cloud computing technologies, AZ900 Azure Fundamentals would be beneficial. Deep experience of Microsoft Office Suite required (extensive knowledge of Power BI and Excel required).
* Previous experiencing with FinOps tooling, specifically Cloudability, would be advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Able to operate successfully in a lean, fast-paced organization, and to create a vision and organization that can scale quickly.
* Highly organized, demonstrated ability to successfully multi-task and efficiently deliver results in ambiguous situation.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**

We're looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure.

Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely.

Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. Passports, financial documents, photographs and identity records flow every day between travellers, partners and government systems across 127 countries. You'll own the cloud infrastructure, security posture and reliability of the platform that processes it, and make sure it scales as we grow.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to pass the next audit, but how to build systems that are fundamentally hard to break.

**The Job**

* **Own our cloud infrastructure.**
  Build and run scalable AWS/GCP infrastructure with Kubernetes and make deployments repeatable and fast.
* **Data security.**
  Design access controls, audit logging across internal tooling and cloud infrastructure for PIIs like passports and financial documents, in line with compliance and data security
* **Secure the supply chain.**
  Add SAST, DAST and dependency and container scanning to CI/CD, run vulnerability management and pen tests
* **Vulnerability Discovery:**
  Find, validate and fix security gaps - business logic flaws, authorization issues, authentication bypasses, injection vulnerabilities

**The Ideal Candidate**

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4–6 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE or security engineering roles, ideally at a fast-growing product company handling sensitive or regulated data.
* Have deep hands-on experience with any public cloud, Linux, networking, Docker and Kubernetes
* Have a strong grounding in security fundamentals including but not limited to OWASP Top 10 and cloud security best practices and have applied them in production, not just on paper.
* You can own security gaps in application layer and can validate and fix them yourself across the tech stack
* Take ownership end to end. You make pragmatic trade-offs between security, speed and developer experience. You explain risk clearly and bring engineers along rather than acting as a gatekeeper.
* Prior web/backend development experience is nice to have.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here's what you can expect:

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

description:
**About The Job**
The Senior Technical Account Manager (STAM) provides leadership and strategic direction for key accounts and is responsible for working independently to lead complex projects, and provide expert technical guidance to customers, and leading the resolution of varied and non-routine complex technical issues. This role exercises independent judgment and creative solutioning to ensure customer success. The STAM may coordinate the activities of other team members (team lead) to ensure successful completion of projects and assignments. This role is responsible for mentoring and providing guidance and advice to new team members. The STAM proactively develops and maintains strategic relationships with key customer stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor and technical leader. This position contributes to overall business growth by driving customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  

* Lead complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution efforts for critical customer issues.
* Develop and deliver technical tutorials and workshops to customers and internal teams.
* Proactively identify and address technical risks and opportunities within customer environments.
* Collaborate with sales and product management teams to develop and support the implementation of customer solutions.
* Serve as a technical mentor and coach for junior team members.
* Contribute to the development of new support tools and processes.
* Lead internal initiatives to improve team performance and customer satisfaction.
* Identify and drive initiatives to improve service delivery processes.
* May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

**What You'll Do**

* Perform technical reviews & share knowledge to proactively identify & prevent issues
* Understand your customers' technical infrastructures, hardware, processes, and offerings
* Perform initial or secondary investigations and respond to online and phone support requests
* Deliver key portfolio updates and assist customers with upgrades
* Manage customer cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans & keep documentation on customer environments updated
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with each qualified engagement through the complete adoption life cycle of our offerings
* Engage with Red Hat's field teams, customers to ensure a positive platform & cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat platform & cloud solutions and our cloud road-map align to customer use cases
* Capture Red Hat product capabilities and identify gaps as related to customer use cases through a closed-loop process for each step of the engagement life cycle
* Engage with Red Hat's product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns based on customer engagements and personal experience that guide platform adoption
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat’s platform & cloud technologies strategy
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas or process areas
* Travel to visit customers, partners, conferences, and other events as needed

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in science or a technical field; engineering or computer science
* Competent reading and writing skills in English
* Ability to convey information to customers in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to effectively manage and grow existing enterprise customer and partner relationships by delivering best-in-class support
* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a passion for problem solving and investigation
* Upstream involvement in open source projects (patches submitted for upstream) is a plus
* Indian citizenship or authorisation to work in India
* Red Hat OpenStack Platform - RHOSP

+ Fundamental understanding of OpenStack, Container architecture, and administration experience across all working components
+ Deep understanding and troubleshooting skills on OpenStack core components.
+ Deployment and troubleshooting experience of OpenStack clusters on bare metal or non-bare metal environments.
+ Planning, Designing, and implementation of OpenStack products on various hardware.
+ Technical and Deep understanding of Ceph cluster storage and its functionalities.
+ Experience with Linux operating system installation, configuration, upgrade, and maintenance.

* Red Hat OpenShift Platform - RHOCP

+ Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Docker cluster management
+ Understanding of RHOCP Architecture & different types of RHOCP installations Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
+ Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
+ Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
+ Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers

* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring & resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that help our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced cloud engineer to work within our cloud engineering practice with a remit to develop, implement, optimize and maintain the AWS infrastructure for Bravura’s cloud hosted clients. The role requires an engineer who can leverage their extensive knowledge of AWS services to build AWS infrastructure using Terraform / Infrastructure as code in both BAU and project contexts.
  
  
You will need to be team focused, working collaboratively with other engineers within the global cloud program, proactively working to leverage and improving Bravura’s standard cloud architecture. You will also have extensive experience in Infrastructure as Code within a Gitlab repository, specifically you will need to be able to demonstrate your ability to write new code and build new pipelines, not just run it. We aim to deliver service building blocks that are simple, generic, secure and repeatable. You will have a quality focus, ensuring that all your deliveries are thoroughly tested.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to build the next generation cloud platform blending a mix of state-of-the-art tools / techniques
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Major focus on low level design, building via automation AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters
* Focus on improving and further automating our SDLC; continuous delivery / continuous deployment pipelines
* Proactively look for opportunities to improve the way build and deliver AWS services more efficiently
* Establish productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Manage the expectations of key stakeholders by facilitating effective communication
* Adopt standard terraform modules to build out AWS infrastructure requirements
* Complete technical documentation including low level designs, technical release notes and unit test artefacts
* Build / Modify Terraform modules to meet architectural requirements
* Assist the Team with resolving security vulnerabilities and issues, including Pen Test findings, AWS security audits, Infosec requirements etc.
* Responding to critical incidents and alerts in accordance with contractual SLAs
* Work closely with other Practices – DevOps, Network and DBA/Middleware in the delivery of infrastructure services.
* Provide mentoring sessions for Junior Team members, document processes, best practices and lessons learned.
* Adopt lateral thinking to trouble shoot issues within the cloud infrastructure stack
* Develop methods to actively improve quality standards
* Collaborate with others to streamline and implement efficient processes
* Help team members to facilitate incident investigation, requirements gathering and technical design activities
* Mentor and regularly engage team members to drive performance and enhance Bravura’s delivery capabilities

**Unleash your potential.**
Key Skills
  
  
  

* AWS infrastructure and services (CloudFormation, EKS, VPC, EC2, IAM, ...)
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (having CKA would be an additional advantage)
* Hands on experience with Terraform/IAC (min 3-4 yrs of experience)
* Hands on experience with CI/CD (Gitlab) and automation tools (min 3 yrs of experience)
* Worked with monitoring / alerting tools such as Promethius and Grafana, AppDynamics
* Good understanding of Linux
* Knowledge of EKS upgrade and patching for UAT and production accounts would be an added advantage.
* Coding/scripting (Bash, Python, Go etc.)
* Good understanding of security fundamentals, including encryption, certificates, etc.
* Good knowledge of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, NAT, etc.
* Strong ability to independently acquire new technical skills to meet a cloud infrastructure requirement.
* An ‘eye for detail’ and quality focus
* Demonstrated customer focus
* Excellent communication and client service skills
* Strong ability to clearly communicate complex technology solutions
* Proactive and forward thinking, with the ability to suggest improvements to current processes and practices
* Flexible and adaptable approach to a range of different tasks
* Able to organize and prioritize your own work, whilst meeting agreed deadlines
* Ability to work respectfully with team members of different skill levels and capabilities
* Reliable and professional

**Preferred**

* Experience with Cloud automation frameworks, DevOps, infrastructure as code and containerization
* Experience with infrastructure and application performance monitoring
* Experience common Cloud Solutions and Services
* AWS Certifications highly regarded
* Change management/JIRA/ServiceNow
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal – able to communicate ideas, concepts, and facts to both projects, peers and senior members of staff.
* Friendly, professional, and business-like approach to clients / Solutions staff.
* Delivery focused.
* Systematic, logical thinker with excellent attention to detail, but able to take a holistic view of the delivery organization and its associated processes.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Minimum 3-4 years of experience in AWS services and infrastructure, particularly EC2, EKS, IAM, VPC, ELB
* Minimum 3-4 years of experience on Terraform coding and its understanding.
* Minimum 3 years of experience of Gitlab CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with Monitoring and Alerting at an infrastructure level, to ensure service interruption is appropriately monitored and alerted.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* Cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Azure Architect – Identity & Access Management (IAM)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Azure Architect specializing in Identity and Access Management (IAM) to lead enterprise-scale identity modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM/FIM), Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity architectures, and large-scale identity migrations.

The candidate must have hands-on experience designing and implementing end-to-end identity solutions, modernizing legacy identity platforms, automating identity lifecycle processes, and integrating enterprise applications and external systems through API-based architectures.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale Azure and Microsoft identity solutions.
* Drive MIM/FIM modernization or replacement initiatives, including assessment, migration planning, implementation, and decommissioning.
* Design and implement large-scale identity migrations, ideally involving 10,000+ user accounts.
* Develop and maintain MIM scripts and Entra ID automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and REST APIs.
* Design hybrid identity solutions integrating on-premises Active Directory with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Implement automated identity provisioning, deprovisioning, synchronization, and lifecycle management.
* Configure and manage Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), RBAC, access reviews, and entitlement management.
* Design and implement SSO and application onboarding using SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
* Integrate identity platforms with enterprise applications, HR systems, ERP platforms, and Student Information Systems.
* Develop API-based integrations with systems such as Workday, Banner SIS, AD LDS, Lenel, and Genetec.
* Troubleshoot complex identity synchronization issues, including attribute mismatches, certificate and URL issues, and synchronization service failures.
* Implement security controls aligned with Zero Trust, least-privilege access, just-in-time (JIT) access, and enterprise security policies.
* Establish monitoring, logging, auditing, incident response, and operational support processes.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, application, and business teams to deliver secure and scalable identity solutions.

Required Technical Skills1. Azure Architecture

* 8+ years of Azure architecture experience.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud-native solutions.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational support.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Automation, API Management, Azure SQL Database, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Microsoft Sentinel.

2. Identity and Access Management

* 12+ years of enterprise IAM architecture experience, as specified in the role requirements.
* At least 5 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Identity Governance.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), Forefront Identity Manager (FIM), and identity synchronization.
* Proven experience leading at least two large-scale MIM/FIM modernization or replacement projects.
* Mandatory hands-on MIM scripting and Entra ID scripting experience.
* Expertise in Microsoft Entra Connect, Entra Cloud Sync, Entra ID Governance, and Entra Provisioning Services.

3. Directory Services and Hybrid Identity

* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, AD LDS, Group Policy, Exchange Online, and hybrid identity architectures.
* Experience with directory synchronization, identity federation, and complex identity scenarios.
* Ability to manage multiple roles or identities associated with a single individual.

4. Identity Security and Governance

* Experience implementing MFA, SSO, Conditional Access, PIM, RBAC, access reviews, entitlement management, and identity attestation.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust principles and least-privilege access.
* Experience with just-in-time access and IP-based access restrictions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity, compliance, audit logging, and incident response.

5. Development and Automation

* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for MIM and Entra ID.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and JSON.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform.
* Ability to automate provisioning, deprovisioning, synchronization, and identity governance workflows.

6. Enterprise Integrations

* Experience integrating identity platforms with Workday, Banner SIS, HR systems, ERP platforms, and Student Information Systems.
* Familiarity with AD LDS and physical access control systems such as Lenel and Genetec.
* Experience implementing event-driven and API-based integrations.
* Knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and application onboarding protocols.

Mandatory Experience and Evaluation Criteria

Candidates must demonstrate:

* End-to-end identity implementation experience, not just production support or maintenance.
* At least two large-scale MIM/FIM modernization or replacement projects.
* Hands-on MIM scripting and Entra ID scripting.
* Large-scale identity migration experience, preferably involving 10,000+ accounts.
* Experience troubleshooting complex synchronization and provisioning scenarios.
* Ability to handle multi-role identities, dual-ID scenarios, and complex identity lifecycle requirements.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications and external systems through APIs.
* Strong understanding of identity security, governance, and access control.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-305, SC-100, SC-300, AZ-104, or SC-200.
* Experience in enterprise identity modernization and cloud security transformation.
* Knowledge of FERPA and other relevant compliance requirements, particularly in education-related environments.

title: Co-Founder & CTO
description:
**I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me.**

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business.

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising.

**What you'll be building:**

* Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development.
* Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure.
* Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future.
* Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users.
* Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow.
* Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions.
* Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features.

**Who I'm looking for:**

* 7–12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development.
* Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers.
* Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything.
* A problem solver who understands business as much as technology.
* Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow.
* Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.

**One thing you should know.**

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort.

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves.

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5–10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there.

**This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement.**
We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently.

I don't expect you to know everything.

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers.

**I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me.**

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo.

**Kush Chauhan | Born at 41.**

**kush@snapzo.in**

title: Lead, Software Engineering
description:

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work
 list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. AI, Insights & Solutions 
team. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. * Develop and maintain APIs and microservices to expose analytics functionality to internal and external consumers, adhering to best practices for API design and documentation.
* Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational policies.
* Continuously monitor and troubleshoot application performance, identifying and resolving issues that impact system reliability, latency, and user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to the establishment and enforcement of coding standards and best practices to ensure high-quality, maintainable code.
* Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in cloud computing, data analytics, and software engineering, and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the capabilities of the analytics platform.

* Collaborate closely with and influence business consulting staff and leaders as part of multi-disciplinary teams to assess opportunities and develop analytics solutions for Bain clients across a variety of sectors.
* Influence, educate and directly support the analytics application engineering capabilities of our clients


  

  
* **ABOUT YOU**

* **6 years minimum experience**
  , 3+ years at Senior or Staff level, or equivalent
* Experience with server-side (back-end) technologies such as, Django, Flask, Fast API
* Experience with client-side (front-end) technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, HTML and CSS

If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

* Strong understanding of Computer Science fundamentals
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with effective articulation and ability to simplify complex ideas along with strong interpersonal skills

**Primary Skills:**

* Strong understanding of the software engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and live site operations.
* Strong Leadership in Technology, including the ability to influence technical discussions and build a technical vision
* Strong understanding of product requirements and being customer-focused, with an emphasis on problem-solving and incident handling

* Must be organized, detail-focused, results-driven, and capable of multitasking in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Experience in hiring
* Self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Skills:**

title: Principal Architect
description:
At S&W, we help our clients thrive by simplifying the complex, illuminating new paths, and shaping solutions that make a difference. As one of the UK’s top 10 fastest-growing accountancy firms, we have been a trusted partner since 1881—helping businesses and individuals meet challenges and seize opportunities across generations.

Built on expertise and driven by ambition, we provide a comprehensive range of services, including tax and accountancy, advisory and assurance, corporate finance, and restructuring. We are defined by our purpose—to help navigate challenges, unlock potential, and achieve the extraordinary.

S&W acquired ClearViewIP in September 2025 to complement the existing advisory services that S&W currently offers its clients including corporate finance, valuations, transaction services and forensic services, along with business tax, audit, consulting and business outsourcing services.

The ClearViewIP team comprises experienced IP professionals, with decades of experience in managing, protecting and commercialising innovation and ensuring best practice IP approaches are deployed to help clients win in the market.

**Job Description**

**Principal Architect – AI-First IP Intelligence Platform**
  
We are transforming a global IP intelligence organization from expert-driven workflows into an AI-first, scalable platform architecture. Our mission is to convert complex, knowledge-intensive IP workflows-prior art search, patent landscape analysis, FTO, competitive intelligence-into modular, explainable, enterprise-grade AI systems.

* **Location:**
  Gurugram, India
* **Working format:**
  5 days per week in the office

**The Role**

You will work closely with the Director and Head of the Workbench Program in the UK, and partner with the India operations team to understand how the work is done today and translate that into the platform. This is an architecture role with long-term platform ownership and significant technical influence. It is not about maintaining existing systems. The foundations are being laid now, and you will be shaping them hands-on:

* AI-native workflows that reason over long technical documents and cite evidence
* Backend services that orchestrate large analytical workloads across a data platform, and the APIs around them.
* Modern frontend experiences built for reviewing output at scale (React/NodeJS or equivalent) - a near-term critical path for this hire
* Secure, enterprise-grade Azure-based deployments, with Databricks as the current leading platform for the data/AI layer.
* Robust DevOps and MLOps foundations, including model evaluation

You will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels-designing long-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company’s growth.

**Qualifications**

**Technical Strengths**

* 12-15+ years in software engineering, with significant architectural ownership
* Experience building large-scale, distributed, enterprise-grade systems
* Proven, hands-on track record designing and building modern backend AND frontend architectures - frontend/UI depth is essential, not a nice-to-have, for this role
* Strong experience in Azure cloud deployments; hands-on Databricks experience (PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow) strongly preferred

**Technical Depth**

* Polyglot capability (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Node.js or similar)
* Data storage and query design: SQL, Delta / Lakehouse patterns, search indexes
* Structured extraction from long documents; structured-output contracts with LLMs
* Batch inference at scale, and the failure modes of long-context model calls
* Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline design
* APIs and service design
* Desirable: vector databases, semantic search, RAG architectures - though our work leans more on verified structured extraction than on retrieval alone
* Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs

**Domain Advantage (Preferred)**

* Experience in IP analytics, patent intelligence, legal tech, or other knowledge-intensive domains
* Exposure to patent data formats, citation networks, IPC/CPC classifications
* Experience building explainable systems in regulated or high-trust environments
