title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.
  
  
This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.
  
  
Learn more about here!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
* Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

title: Director - T&O Data Engineering
description:
**About This Role**
The BlackRock Data Office (BDO) advances the firm's enterprise data strategy by building trusted, scalable, and governed data products that power investment, business, operational, and technology outcomes across BlackRock. As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. The team is at the forefront of shaping BlackRock's next generation data ecosystem and driving data as a strategic asset across the firm.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As a Director, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms architect who wants to do more than produce designs or provide technical advice, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.
* Proven architecture leadership and technical judgment across workflow orchestration, Data Operations, release management, observability, cloud infrastructure, and source-control and delivery platforms, with the ability to simplify systems and make pragmatic trade-offs.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Cloud Sales Specialist (AWS/GCP & Azure Sales)- Gurgaon
description:
**Title:**
Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist - AWS/GCP and Azure Sales

**Location:**
Mumbai/ Gurgaon/ Bangalore

**About the Role:**

NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and

Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate

cloud, data and AI transformation.

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led

business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate

within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units,

hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organisations.

The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity

orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer

conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler

capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.

The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organisational boundaries,

influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud

technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation**

* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed sales/revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP opportunities.

**2. Client Engagement & Consultative Selling**

* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner.

**3. Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration**

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU

sales teams across NTT DATA.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and strategy.
* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer engagements.
* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.

**4. Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement**

* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.
* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and hyperscaler platforms.
* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.

**5. Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership**

* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition, stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.
* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
* Drive opportunities from initial qualification → solution shaping → proposal → negotiation → closure.

**6. Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding**

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with

customers and technical stakeholders across:

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS
* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand

customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to

business outcomes.

**7. Internal Orchestration**

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities,

bringing together:

Client Manager → BU → Cloud Specialist → Presales/Solution Architecture → Delivery →

Hyperscaler → Commercial/Finance

**Responsibilities include:**

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.
* Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology consulting organisation preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.

**Strong understanding of:**

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services
* Cloud security
* Digital transformation
* Sales Competencies
* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

Key job responsibilities

title: Principal Architect, Data Architecture & Design
description:
**Principal Architect, Data Architecture and Design**
The Principal Technical Architect provides technical leadership for complex data and analytics solutions across multiple programs and business domains. This role is responsible for translating business strategy into scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions while partnering closely with engineering, product, governance, and business teams. The architect combines strong solution design expertise with practical technical depth to ensure architecture standards, patterns, and best practices are successfully implemented in delivery.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Define and drive solution architecture strategies, standards, and reference patterns for enterprise Data & Analytics initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader technology and business objectives.
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions, producing architecture blueprints, technical designs, integration frameworks, and data models that accelerate delivery and adoption.
* Establish reusable architecture patterns and reference implementations for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption to improve consistency, reduce technical debt, and enhance engineering productivity.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into practical technical roadmaps, solution designs, and phased implementation plans.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, and architectural approaches, providing expert recommendations that drive innovation and long-term business value.
* Conduct architecture, design, and technical quality reviews to ensure solutions meet enterprise requirements for scalability, reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate with Data Governance and Security teams to embed data privacy, compliance, access controls, and risk management principles into solution architectures.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and technology evaluations for advanced analytics, cloud platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and next-generation data architectures to determine business and technical fit.
* Provide hands-on leadership in resolving complex technical challenges related to performance, integration, scalability, reliability, and operational support across enterprise platforms.
* Mentor engineers and architects, champion architectural best practices, and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across the organization.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; Cloud Architecture (Azure, AWS, GCP) and TOGAF certifications are highly desirable.
* 10-14 years of experience in Data Engineering, Solution Architecture, or Technical Architecture roles, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, enterprise data and analytics platforms.
* Deep expertise in modern cloud data ecosystems, including Azure, Databricks, Lakehouse architectures, and enterprise-scale data platforms, with the ability to guide teams through complex technical challenges.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL, Python, data modeling, ETL/ELT, CDC, dimensional modeling, and scalable data architecture patterns, with a focus on performance, resilience, and maintainability.
* Experience integrating complex enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, Salesforce, or similar ERP platforms, spanning commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and operational data domains.
* Demonstrated ability to design governed, consumption-ready data products with robust data quality, lineage, security, semantic modeling, and analytics capabilities.
* Strong understanding of API-driven, event-based, and cloud-native architectures, including DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and modern engineering practices.
* Proven ability to influence architectural decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and build consensus across engineering, product, governance, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.

title: Sr Network Architect (network + cloud+ security)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  
  
**About this role:**
Senior Network Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic vision, lifecycle planning, and architectural design of highly reliable, secure, and scalable multi-cloud and enterprise network infrastructure to support Gartner Conference and global business operations. The ideal candidate brings expert-level mastery in enterprise network design, zero-trust security frameworks, edge connectivity, and hybrid cloud ecosystems. They are passionate about setting architectural guardrails, authoring long-term technology roadmaps, and leveraging modern software-defined networking (SDN) and automation frameworks to drive transformative business outcomes.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Define Strategy: Architect the global enterprise network blueprint spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, multi-cloud ecosystems, and high-density event environments.
* Lead Security Architecture: Design enterprise-wide network security frameworks, integrating next-generation firewalls, SASE, zero-trust models, and micro-segmentation.
* Author Roadmaps: Establish long-term technology roadmaps, standard reference designs, and architectural guardrails Campus office, Data Center, and cloud connectivity.
* Drive Innovation: Evaluate and select emerging technologies, leading proof-of-concepts for SDN, intent-based networking, network automation, and AI frameworks.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with infrastructure team, application team, Infosec team, DevOps Team, Cloud CCOE team and End user team.
* Govern Documentation: Own the lifecycle of core reference architectures, global topology diagrams, infrastructure-as-code libraries, and standard compliance guidelines.
* Act as Highest Escalation: Serve as the ultimate technical authority for systemic, complex infrastructure or application performance anomalies.
* Mentor Teams: Provide technical governance and mentorship to senior network engineering teams, cultivating engineering excellence across the organization.

**What you’ll need:**

* Professional Experience: 12-17 years of deep technical experience in large-scale enterprise routing, switching, and complex network infrastructure design..
* Technical Governance: Ability to author and maintain global network architectural standards, high-level designs (HLD), low-level designs (LLD), and deployment blueprints.
* Core Routing & Switching: Master-level understanding of advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) alongside high-density data center fabrics (spine-leaf) and modern campus network topologies.
* Enterprise Wireless: Deep technical knowledge of enterprise wireless LAN (WLAN) controllers, cloud-managed Wi-Fi architecture, RF engineering, and centralized wireless management platforms.
* Application Delivery & Load Balancing: Advanced, hands-on knowledge of F5 BIG-IP systems (LTM, DNS, APM), including deep familiarity with SSL/TLS termination, HTTP/HTTPS profiles, and iRules.
* Palo Alto Security Design: Strong experience in Palo Alto Networks infrastructure, designing secure deployments utilizing Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) managed via Strata Cloud Manager, user-ID/app-ID policies, and cloud-delivered security services.
* SASE & Edge Architecture: Expertise to architect and scale Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and SD-WAN frameworks to provide optimized, secure connectivity for remote users and branch offices.
* Multi-Cloud Networking: Deep knowledge of cloud-native networking constructs, designing and securing high-performance transit networks across AWS (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPCs) and Microsoft Azure (Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, vNets).

**Who You Are**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in BE/B tech, ME/MTech or MCA are preferred.
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Ardent desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**

title: Software Development Engineer III
description: What is Hunch?Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.Link to our fundraising announcementKey Offerings Of HunchOne Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.About The RoleWe're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.What You'll Do Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket. Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy). Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.) Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users. Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.What You'll Bring 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus. Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.Preferred ExperienceML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.What We OfferCompetitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).Life at HunchHunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.What We Hire For - The ABCsMost companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.How We WorkOwnership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.Backed by Global InvestorsHunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.Experienced LeadershipHunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

title: Hybrid Cloud Engineer
description:
**Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services**
At HH Global, we help the world’s most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation.
  
  
We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing execution at scale.
  
  
With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you’ll join a diverse, high-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.
  
  
**Purpose of the Job**
As a Hybrid Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying and maintaining our hybrid cloud infrastructure to meet the evolving needs of our clients. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including software developers, system administrators, and network engineers, to ensure seamless integration and superior performance of our hybrid cloud solutions. Your expertise of infrastructure, cloud technologies and automation will be instrumental in delivering reliable, scalable, and secure hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to assess infrastructure requirements to maintain and support hybrid cloud solutions that align with client needs and business goals.
* Plan, implement, and manage the deployment of hybrid cloud infrastructure, utilizing a combination of on-premises and cloud resources.
* Configure, monitor, and optimize virtualized environments, including virtual machines, containers, and microservices.
* Oversee the integration of various cloud services and technologies, ensuring seamless interoperability and optimal performance.
* Implement security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, and vulnerability assessments, to maintain a secure hybrid cloud environment.
* Collaborate with network engineers to monitor and maintain networking components, ensuring robust connectivity between on-premises and cloud resources.
* Understand, automate deployment, scaling, and management tasks using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools and methodologies.
* Monitor and analyze system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive measures to ensure high availability and reliability.
* Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to hybrid cloud, infrastructure, and automation.
* Participate in the IT On call Rota & Patching Rota where needed to support the server estates and business.
* Undertake BAU activities to support the 3rd Line BAU Team, working on incidents calls and escalations, providing expert technical troubleshooting skills to resolve complex issues and providing root cause analysis reports.
* Create and maintain accurate operational documentation, including SOPs, service catalogues (SCs) and supporting technical records, while following ITIL best practices for incident, problem and change management.
* Hybrid Virtual Machine Builds & Maintenance, Assist with the deployment and maintenance of virtual machines in both Azure and on-premise environments (VMware, Hyper-V), including template-based configurations, patching, and day-to-day operational support.
* Monitoring, Alerting, & Security Support for Hybrid Systems, Monitor Azure and on-premise infrastructures (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), manage alerts and perform security checks using tools like Azure Security Center, Windows Defender, and on-premise monitoring solutions, escalating issues when necessary.
* Hybrid Endpoint Configuration & Device Management, Support the deployment, configuration, and monitoring of devices using Microsoft Intune for both cloud and on-premise systems, ensuring devices meet organizational security standards. Assist with managing endpoint protection using Windows Defender and on-premise solutions.
* Networking & Traffic Management Support (Cloud & On-Premise), Assist with the configuration and operational management of networking components in both Azure (Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, DNS) and on-premise environments (e.g., VMware NSX, physical network components), ensuring consistent availability and performance.
* Access & Identity Management Support (Hybrid), Support the day-to-day management of Azure SSO, App Registrations, and key management tasks, as well as identity access controls for on-premise systems (VMware, Active Directory), ensuring secure access to both cloud and on-premise services.
* Support for Secure Infrastructure & PKI (Hybrid), Assist with the maintenance and support of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and security solutions across both Azure and on-premise environments, ensuring secure communication and compliance.

**Knowledge, Skills + Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect) are a plus.
* Proven experience in infrastructure engineering, or related roles within the IT industry.
* Solid understanding of hybrid cloud concepts, virtualization, and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).
* Solid understanding of VMware, Hyper V, Azure HCI technologies
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation and infrastructure management.
* Desirable experience and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Desirable experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of networking concepts, including VPN, VPC, subnets, and security groups, in a hybrid cloud environment.
* Strong security mindset and knowledge of security best practices in hybrid cloud environments.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience in managing and supporting a diverse range of operating systems and platforms, including Windows and Linux environments, as well as containerization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, and related orchestration tools. Familiarity with system administration, configuration management, and troubleshooting in these ecosystems is essential.

**You belong in our global community**
Belonging is at the heart of HH Global. We don’t just talk about inclusion; our teams recognize it as a fundamental part of our culture. Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services and bring your authentic self to a team that values you for who you are.
  
  
We welcome job applications from all suitably qualified candidates and will make reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process to accommodate you.

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**About ZENNER Aquamet**

At ZENNER Aquamet, we develop modern software solutions that power connected IoT ecosystems and enable secure,

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

support customers across utilities, smart infrastructure, and industrial domains. We foster a collaborative environment

where engineers can learn, contribute, and grow through real-world product development.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically versatile, and hands-on Technical Lead to drive the design,

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

The selected professional will take end-to-end technical ownership of projects, resolve complex engineering challenges,

guide development teams, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Take complete technical ownership of software projects, covering requirement analysis, technical planning,

solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Independently architect, design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications, mobile

applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.

• Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistent user experience, performance,

and accessibility.

• Develop robust frontend and backend applications, reusable components, scalable services, and secure integration

mechanisms.

• Architect, deploy, configure, secure, and manage production environments on both AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and maintain databases, data processing pipelines, distributed systems, caching mechanisms, and highvolume data handling solutions.

• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure automation, and application

release processes.

• Ensure system availability, performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and disaster recovery across

production environments.

• Design and implement secure, scalable IoT applications, including device connectivity, telemetry processing, realtime monitoring, and third-party platform integrations.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

• Evaluate technology choices, define solution architectures, prepare technical documentation, and recommend

appropriate implementation approaches.

• Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, coordinate development activities, and collaborate with

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

• Extensive hands-on proficiency in programming languages and modern application development technologies,

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

• Strong practical experience with modern frameworks and technologies such as Angular, React, Next.js, Django,

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

• Strong analytical ability, architectural decision-making, technical documentation, problem-solving, and leadership

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

• B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech/M.E., MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology,

Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including hands-on development, solution architecture,

cloud infrastructure, and technical leadership.

• Proven experience leading complex software projects and independently managing technical responsibilities

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

• Demonstrated expertise in designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads on both

AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Prior professional experience working on IoT-based products, platforms, or enterprise IoT integration solutions is

mandatory.

• Proven ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain complete enterprise software solutions.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Skills

• AWS and Microsoft Azure certifications in solution architecture, cloud engineering, DevOps, or related

specializations.

• Experience developing IoT solutions for smart metering, utilities, smart infrastructure, industrial systems, or device

management.

• Familiarity with LoRaWAN Network Servers (LNS), IoT gateways, communication protocols, and integration with

external IoT platforms.

• Experience working with multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, large-scale distributed systems, and

enterprise security architectures.

• Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI-powered applications, and intelligent automation.

• Experience mentoring engineering teams, managing multiple technical initiatives, and providing technical guidance

across the software delivery lifecycle

title: Senior Specialist - Data
description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.
  
  
When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.
  
  
Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The SME, Data and Analytics/ Data Solution Designer plays a pivotal role within our evolving Data Engineering team, leading the strategic implementation of data solutions on AWS. You will be responsible for driving the technical vision and execution of cloud-based data architectures, ensuring the platform’s scalability, security, and performance while addressing both business and technical requirements.
  
  
This role demands a hands-on lead role with deep technical expertise who can also steer strategic initiatives to success.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Spearhead the implementation, performance fine-tuning, development, and delivery of data solutions using AWS core data services, driving innovation in Data Engineering, Governance, Integration, and Virtualization.
* Oversee all technical aspects of AWS-based data systems, ensuring end-to-end delivery.
* Coordinating with multiple stakeholders to ensure timely implementation and effective value realization.
* Continuously enhance the D&A platform to improve performance, resiliency, scalability, and security while incorporating new data technologies and methodologies.
* Work closely with business partners, data architects, and cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.
* Develop and implement data management strategies, including Data Lakehouse, Data Warehousing, Master Data Management, and Advanced Analytics solutions.
* Combine technical solutioning with hands-on work as needed, actively contributing to the architecture, coding, and deployment of critical data systems.
* Ensure system health by monitoring platform performance, identifying potential issues, and taking preventive or corrective measures as needed.
* Be accountable for the accuracy, consistency, and overall quality of the data used in various applications and analytical processes.
* Advocate for the use of best practices in data engineering, governance, and AWS cloud technologies, advising on the latest tools and standards.

**Requirements**

* 8-10 years of experience in data engineering, solution design, or data architecture with strong AWS exposure.
* Proven experience designing and implementing AWS data services (such as S3, Redshift, Athena, Glue, Lambda, etc.) and a solid understanding of data service design patterns.
* Demonstrated expertise and hands-on proficiency in PySpark for designing, building, and optimizing large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines on AWS—essential for this role.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code for infrastructure automation, version control integration, and CI/CD-driven deployment and management of AWS data infrastructure.
* Expertise in building large-scale data platforms, including enterprise level Data Lakehouse, Data warehouse systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with multi-disciplinary teams and aligning data strategies with business objectives.
* Collaborate with cross-country stakeholders to align requirements, dependencies, and implementation timelines.
* Demonstrate ability to optimize cloud costs and resource utilization in large-scale data environments without compromising performance.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions and approach challenges methodically.
* Proficiency in data solution coding, ensuring access and integration for analytical and decision-making processes.
* Good verbal & written communication skills and ability to work independently as well as in a team environment providing structure in ambiguous situation.

**Good to have**

* Experience within the Insurance domain is an added advantage.
* Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and Master Data Management principles.
* AWS or relevant cloud/data certifications are an advantage
* Experience with API-based integration patterns for data pipelines and system connectivity.

This role is ideal for a hands-on Data Solution Designer who can balance solution design, technical delivery, and business alignment across regional teams.
  
  
**Job Category:**
IT - Digital Development
  
  
**Posting End Date:**
21/10/2026

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Xceedance is a pioneering company and a strategic partner for transformation in the insurance industry. We’re a global provider of insurance analytics and consulting services to property/casualty insurers, reinsurers, brokers, managing general agents and program administrators. With offices in India, the United States, United Kingdom & Poland serving a diverse community of clients, Xceedance partners with insurers to launch new products, drive operations, implement cutting-edge technology, and deliver advanced analytics capabilities and process optimization. Our company deploys teams of experienced insurance professionals to help insurers worldwide enhance policyholder service, enter new markets, boost workflow productivity and improve profitability.

Xceedance has achieved phenomenal growth in the past three years — a tribute to the knowledge, scope and impact of our people around the world. Everyone is laser focused on delivering value to our customers. We are committed to the communities in which we live and work. We are driven by a culture of innovation and integrity.

As a member of the Xceedance team, you can shape a fulfilling career, participate in exciting projects and impact the organization in meaningful ways. Count on strong support to develop skills, grow quickly and meet your professional aspirations. Relish working in a highly collaborative setting that features state-of-the-art resources, modern technology and a comfortable, gratifying environment. Create solutions and fulfill your role alongside highly talented and dynamic colleagues who will motivate you to be agile and extremely productive. And enjoy the advantages of a superior benefits package.

Join us if you’re looking for an opportunity to be inspired, challenged and rewarded!

**Position Title: Enterprise Architect**

Job Description Summary: We are seeking a seasoned Enterprise Architect to own the alignment between business strategy and enterprise technology direction. The ideal candidate brings deep experience translating executive priorities into a defensible, multi-year technology roadmap; running formal architecture governance (Engineering Design Authority, Architecture Review Board); leading legacy-to-cloud modernization across multiple systems and teams; and identifying overlapping tools and technical debt that inflate cost of ownership. This role sits above individual product or platform architecture — it requires enterprise-wide ownership of governance, risk, and technology investment, with credibility to operate directly with business leadership and the CXO/board.

**Location: NCR / Bangalore / Pune**

**Experience: 15 - 18 Years+**

**Job Description and Responsibilities**

• Own alignment between enterprise IT strategy and overall business strategy, translating multi-year executive priorities into a defensible technology investment roadmap.

• Define and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — business, application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers — ensuring design coherence across the full platform and product portfolio.

• Establish and enforce enterprise technology governance: standards for tool selection, build-vs-buy decisions, coding practices, reference architectures, and architectural compliance across engineering teams.

• Own enterprise risk management for the technology estate — identify architectural, security, and operational weak spots in current systems and drive remediation plans through to closure.

• Act as the primary technical translator between business leadership and engineering, presenting architecture options, trade-offs, risks, and roadmaps in business terms to executive stakeholders.

• Partner with business and product leaders to convert business requirements into target-state technical solutions, with clear traceability from business capability to system design.

• Chair the Engineering Design Authority (EDA) reviewing and approving (or rejecting) new project designs against enterprise standards prior to funding and build sign-off.

• Drive technology and tool rationalization across business units — identify overlapping or redundant platforms and build the business case for consolidation to lower total cost of ownership.

• Define enterprise-wide non-functional standards covering performance, scalability, resilience, security, and regulatory/data-privacy compliance.

• Build and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that delivery teams across the organization can adopt directly.

• Own the technology vendor and product evaluation process, ensuring new tools and platforms meet enterprise architecture, security, and integration standards before onboarding.

• Mentor senior architects and technical leads, building architecture maturity, bench-strength, and succession depth across the organization.

• Track and report architecture governance compliance, approved exceptions, and technical debt exposure to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

**Essential Qualifications and Skills**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 15–18 years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise architecture, including at least 5 years operating at an enterprise-wide (not single-product) architecture level.

• Proven experience running formal architecture governance bodies (ARB, EDA, or equivalent) with real decision-making authority over project approvals and exceptions.

• Strong practical grounding in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or Zachman, applied to real governance and roadmap decisions, not just certification knowledge.

• Track record of building and defending a multi-year technology roadmap directly to CXO or board-level stakeholders.

• Experience driving technology portfolio rationalization and cost optimization with quantified, defensible outcomes.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), modern data architecture, integration patterns, and security/compliance frameworks.

• Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to operate independently with business unit heads, CXOs, and regulators.

• TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification strongly preferred.

**Desirable Qualifications and Skills**

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, BFSI, or other regulated, transaction-heavy domains.

• Exposure to policy administration, billing, claims, or reporting platforms within the insurance value chain.

• Experience architecting for regulatory and compliance regimes (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, insurance-specific regulatory frameworks).

• Experience building or scaling an enterprise architecture governance function from the ground up.

• Prior ownership of a technology budget or P&L, with direct accountability for cost outcomes.

• Leadership experience across globally distributed or virtual teams.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

• A published, executive-approved multi-year enterprise technology roadmap with a clear line of sight to business strategy.

• EDA and ARB operate as genuine decision gates — projects are approved or rejected against defined criteria, not rubber-stamped.

• A measurable reduction in overlapping tools and licenses, with quantified total-cost-of-ownership savings.

• Legacy systems migrated to modern cloud architecture against a documented, risk-managed plan with minimal business disruption.

• Business and technology leadership rely on the enterprise architecture function as the trusted authority for major technology decisions.

THE ROLE
  
  
Grow into architecture through the supply side — learn how offer-based systems, publisher interfaces, and payout pipelines are designed for fairness, transparency, and creator trust.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Study and document existing system architecture — data flows, service boundaries, and integration points
* Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to design discussions
* Write technical specifications and architecture decision records (ADRs)
* Build proof-of-concept implementations to validate architectural hypotheses
* Learn and apply design patterns — domain-driven design, event sourcing, CQRS, microservices
* Shadow senior engineers on system design, capacity planning, and incident post-mortems

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong CS fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, system design basics
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (TypeScript/Node.js preferred)
* Genuine curiosity about how systems work at scale — not just coding, but designing
* Ability to read and reason about unfamiliar codebases
* Willingness to learn fast and take on responsibility beyond your experience level

EARLY CAREER & CAMPUS TALENT
  
  
We are actively inviting
**early-career graduates**
and
**final-year interns**
to consider long-term opportunities in innovation and establish stable careers with us in one of the most promising industry segments. If you are looking to create a ding in the universe, this may be your chance.
  
  
Blowtrumpet is not just offering a job — we are offering a seat at the table where the future of advertising technology is being designed. You will work with small, focused teams, learn from practitioners, ship real products, and grow into a career that compounds.
  
  
STATEMENT OF PURPOSE
  
  
Along with your application, please include a
**Statement of Purpose**
that covers:
  
  

* What interests you in advertising and technology — what drew you to this space?
* When you started programming, designing, exploring this opportunity, or engaging with the field — and what you have built or learned so far.
* Your 3–5 year career vision — where do you see yourself, what kind of work excites you, and what impact do you want to make?
* How Blowtrumpet or this project fits into that picture — why us, why now, and what you hope to bring.

WORKING AT BLOWTRUMPET
  
  
We function like a startup — and we are proud of it. That means you will wear multiple hats, take ownership beyond your title, and grow faster than you would in a larger organisation. We are looking for people who thrive on that kind of pace.
  
  
**A Few Things To Know Upfront**
