title: AI & Agentic Platform Architect Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an accomplished Associate Director – AI & Agentic Platform Architect to lead the architecture, engineering and operational evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms that drive intelligent operations and digital employee experiences.
  
  
This role spans the complete Build → Deploy → Operate → Improve lifecycle and requires deep expertise across Agentic AI, Generative AI, Enterprise Application Architecture, Data & Knowledge Platforms, Automation, Observability and AI Operations.
  
  
As a key technology leader, you will be responsible for defining the enterprise architecture strategy for AI-powered platforms, designing scalable and resilient solutions, and ensuring successful adoption and operation of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. You will work across business, engineering, architecture and operations teams to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, governed and production-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
Success in this role requires a proven ability to architect, build and operate secure, resilient and highly available enterprise products at scale while driving innovation, operational excellence and enterprise adoption of AI-powered solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end architecture vision, standards and technical strategy for enterprise AI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Design single-agent and multi-agent architectures encompassing orchestration, reasoning, collaboration, memory, context management, tool integration and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Architect AI-powered operational capabilities that observe, correlate, diagnose, predict, prevent and resolve technology issues.
* Design intelligent conversational experiences capable of understanding user and technology context, diagnosing issues and safely initiating actions.
* Architect enterprise knowledge and intelligence platforms leveraging structured and unstructured data, operational telemetry, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic and hybrid retrieval, and knowledge graph technologies.
* Define Generative AI architecture covering model strategy, model routing, grounding, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails and performance optimization.
* Architect scalable enterprise applications utilizing distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native engineering patterns.
* Establish reusable integration patterns across enterprise applications, operational systems, data platforms and automation services.
* Define architecture standards for identity, security, privacy, Responsible AI, explainability, auditability and governance.
* Establish engineering standards covering scalability, availability, resilience, performance, maintainability and security.
* Lead architecture governance, technology evaluations, design reviews and strategic build-versus-buy decisions.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship and guidance across architecture, engineering and platform teams.
* Provide technical leadership across the full product lifecycle, from engineering and release management through production operations and continuous improvement.
* Ensure enterprise AI services consistently meet availability, reliability, performance, scalability and service-level objectives.
* Establish end-to-end observability across applications, infrastructure, data platforms, AI models and agent workflows.
* Drive incident management, problem management and reliability engineering practices, including root-cause analysis and prevention of recurring production issues.
* Establish operational readiness frameworks covering release governance, capacity planning, resilience validation and disaster recovery.
* Define and implement AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices covering quality, performance, latency, evaluation, telemetry, failure management and cost optimization.
* Utilize operational insights to continuously improve platform architecture, engineering quality, user experience and business outcomes.
* Engage, influence and manage senior technology and business stakeholders, including CTO-level leaders, to align AI platform strategy, architecture decisions and delivery priorities with enterprise objectives.
* Lead, mentor and develop high-performing teams, providing people leadership, coaching, performance guidance and capability-building across architecture, engineering and platform functions.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deep expertise in enterprise architecture, modern application engineering and AI platform design.
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI, Generative AI, multi-agent systems, orchestration frameworks, memory architectures, tool integration and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Proven ability to architect and operate large-scale, highly available and resilient enterprise platforms.
* Expertise in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native engineering.
* Strong understanding of enterprise knowledge platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic retrieval, hybrid retrieval and knowledge graph architectures.
* Experience establishing observability, reliability engineering, AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices for enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity management, privacy, governance and Responsible AI principles.
* Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to balance innovation, governance and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and executive engagement skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, lead complex initiatives and mentor high-performing engineering teams.
* Ability to drive solutions from concept through architecture, engineering, production deployment, operations and continuous improvement.

**Ideally, you'll also**

* Bring strong hands-on experience with .NET / C# and enterprise application architecture.
* Have experience with Microsoft Agent Framework or comparable agent orchestration platforms.
* Have experience with Microsoft Foundry or comparable enterprise AI development, governance and operations platforms.
* Demonstrate experience designing and implementing multi-agent and tool-enabled AI systems.
* Possess experience with cloud-native application development, containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Have experience with enterprise data platforms, lakehouse architectures, knowledge graphs and advanced retrieval technologies.
* Demonstrate experience implementing AIOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and enterprise observability practices.
* Bring experience working within large, complex and globally distributed enterprise technology environments.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a builder, architect and operator who understands how AI, Data, Knowledge, Applications, Integration, Automation, Security and Operations come together to form a unified enterprise platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a balanced combination of strategic architectural thinking, deep technical expertise and operational excellence. They understand that enterprise-scale Agentic AI requires context, identity, memory, permissions, tools, workflows, observability, evaluation, governance, resilience and human oversight to deliver trusted business outcomes.
  
  
Most importantly, we are seeking an individual who can architect, build, deploy, operate and continuously evolve secure, resilient and scalable AI platforms, while driving innovation and enabling enterprise-wide adoption of next-generation intelligent solutions.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Company: SCIKIQ Data Private Limited

Industry Type- Product & Services

Location: Gurugram, Sector 32

Work Mode: Work from Office (5 days a week)

Experience: 12+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

**About SCIKIQ**

SCIKIQ is an AI-native, no-code data platform from Gurugram. Enterprises use it to connect their data, govern it (catalog, lineage, data quality, policies) and use it through dashboards, data products and AI copilots for varied Use cases.

* Strong SQL with working Python understanding
* Hands-on with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift or similar.
* Strong in Power BI, Tableau or Qlik or any other BI tool

* Explains things simply to business and tech teams. Comfortable on the ground with customers. Good communication skill required

description:

title: Cloud Administrator
description:

4. Enforce security through automated user and access management.
5. Diagnose and resolve performance issues using modern diagnostic tools.

**Specific Role Responsibilities:-**

* Maintain and monitor Azure and AWS database services to ensure high availability and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues, optimize queries, and meet performance SLAs.

* Quality of security documentation and adherence to cloud security standards.

**Experience Required**

* Proven ability to work as an individual, with excellent self-management and time management skills.
* Ability to participate in an on-call roster and perform some work outside normal business hours.

* Experience with other cloud data storage services such as Microsoft Fabric or Power BI .
* Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.

As Splunk Platform Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical and strategic advisor to service provider leaders across the region. You will bridge complex telecommunications and network challenges with modern data platforms, observability, and AI to transform operations and monetize digital capabilities.
  
  

* Engage service provider executives and senior technical stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation goals. Explore areas of focus and uncover customer pain points. Once discovered, shape data and AI strategies for network operations, service assurance, customer experience, automation, security, and business operations.
* Design and communicate solution architectures spanning telemetry, observability, security data, network data, enterprise data platforms, analytics, and AI.
* Translate complex service provider challenges into practical platform strategies, solution architecture and working prototypes.
* Demonstrate how data platforms such as Splunk can help organisations improve visibility, reduce operational complexity, accelerate incident response, and enable data-driven decisions.
* Work closely with account teams, sales specialists, solution engineers, customer success, professional services, partners, and product teams.
* Enable field teams and customers through workshops, executive briefings, architecture sessions, demonstrations, and industry engagements.
* Identify repeatable patterns and differentiated use cases across various domains including 5G, cloud, OSS/BSS, network automation, observability, cybersecurity, and customer experience.
* Work with service providers to identify, shape, and solution API monetisation services. Connect business opportunities to architectures that expose network and digital capabilities through APIs, and consider the supporting data, analytics, security, integration, and operational requirements needed to deliver customer and partner value.
* Contribute to thought leadership through customer presentations, white papers, industry forums, and events such as TM Forum and Mobile World Congress.
* Bring external market, technology, and customer insights back into business strategy, solution development, and field enablement.

**Success Measures**

* Establishing trusted relationships with senior service provider stakeholders.
* Creating differentiated data and AI architecture strategies, designs, use cases and prototypes that address real operational and business challenges.
* Influencing customer adoption of modern data platform capabilities.
* Enabling account teams and partners to have stronger, more strategic customer conversations.
* Building repeatable service provider use cases and architecture patterns that can be rolled out to others.
* Strengthening the organisation’s position as a thought leader in service provider data-driven transformation.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably from a product discussion to an industry conversation to an enterprise data and transformation strategy-design and should be able to build prototypes when needed.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 12+ years experience in the telecommunications or service provider industry, with credibility across network, cloud, operations, assurance, automation, security, or customer experience domains.
* Deep experience in one or two service provider domains, combined with a sound working understanding of the others. Relevant domains include fixed wireline, wireless, mobile core, RAN, packet core, optical, transport/IP, 5G, network functions virtualization, cloud-native networking, OSS/BSS, network automation, and service assurance.
* The ability to communicate effectively with service provider executives, enterprise architects, network architects, NOC/SOC leaders, operations teams, and engineering organizations.
* Experience developing or influencing complex solution architectures in large-scale, multi-domain environments, and the ability to connect business outcomes and operational challenges to platform capabilities and architecture decisions.
* A strong understanding of data platforms, data architecture, telemetry, observability, analytics, AI, or security data solutions. Experience with Splunk or other enterprise data, observability, analytics, cloud, or security platforms is valuable.
* Knowledge of Cisco and other technologies and architectures relevant to service providers, as well as an understanding of autonomous and agentic architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong executive handling, consulting skills, storytelling ability, and confidence leading strategic customer conversations. Experience working across sales, presales, product, engineering, delivery, and customer success teams is valuable.
* A curious, collaborative, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to operate across strategic and technical conversations.
* Experience advising customers on platform adoption, operating models, data governance, or transformation roadmaps. A background in enterprise architecture, consulting, technical sales, solution architecture, or senior customer advisory roles is valuable.
* Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks, Open APIs, industry standards, or service provider transformation programmes.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

**Position Summary:**
The Azure Implementation Engineer is responsible for

as part of structured delivery projects. The role works closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, and Security teams to implement approved designs, execute migration waves, and prepare environments for steady-state operations.
  
  
The position requires
**hands-on Azure deployment skills**
and
**basic Active Directory knowledge**
to support hybrid enterprise workloads.
  
  
This is primarily a
**project delivery and implementation role**
, with limited post-go-live stabilization support.
  
  
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
Working in collaboration with the Regional Service Centre and Azure Delivery teams, responsibilities include:
  
  
**Azure Implementation & Project Delivery**

* Implement Azure landing zones and subscription structures as per approved architecture.
* Deploy core Azure services: Virtual Machines, VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage Accounts.
* Configure availability, backup, DR, and security baselines.
* Execute workload onboarding and cutover activities during migration projects.
* Perform build, test, and production go-live activities.
* Prepare implementation guides, build documents, and handover packs.
* Participate in design walkthroughs and technical workshops with customers.

**Migration Execution**

* Perform on-prem to Azure and cloud-to-cloud migrations.
* Assist with discovery and assessment phases using Azure Migrate.
* Execute replication and cutover activities using ASR and Data Box.
* Support post-migration stabilisation and optimisation phases.
* Track technical actions for migration waves and project milestones.

**Identity & Active Directory**

* Support identity integration between on-prem AD and Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Perform user/group sync checks and RBAC configuration.
* Understand AD fundamentals: OUs, DNS, Group Policy basics.
* Assist with MFA and conditional access rollout as part of projects.

**Automation & Tooling**

* Implement builds using ARM, Bicep, or Terraform templates for to deploy VNets, AKS clusters, and SQL databases.
* Support Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure deployment.
* Use PowerShell / Azure CLI for automation during migrations and builds.

**Security Implementation**

* Hardening the environment by Zero Trust principles.
* Configuring Microsoft Entra ID (IAM) and enforcing Azure Policies.

**AI Integration**

* Build infra for Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search.

**Operational Readiness & Handover**

* Assist in operational readiness activities before transition to support teams.
* Create SOPs and runbooks for steady-state environments.
* Participate in knowledge-transfer sessions with managed services teams.
* Ensure governance, tagging, and security standards are implemented before handover.

* 5+ years in cloud or infrastructure delivery roles.
* Strong hands-on Azure implementation experience.
* Proven involvement in migration or transformation projects.
* Working knowledge of:

+ Azure Compute, Storage, Networking
+ Azure AD / RBAC / Hybrid Identity basics

* Windows and Linux administration experience.
* Basic automation/scripting exposure.
* Experience working in professional services / project-based delivery environments.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Characteristics**

* Delivery-oriented mindset with strong documentation skills.
* Comfortable working with project plans and milestones.
* Customer-facing experience during implementations.
* Ability to follow architecture designs and escalate risks early.

* AZ-500 (Azure Security Engineer)

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Role Overview

* Role: Solution & Integration Architect
* Team: Technology
* Reporting to: Global CTO
* Location: Mumbai or Delhi, India
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: Typically 8–12+ years, including at least 3 years in solution architecture or a technical leadership role.

Role Purpose

The Solution & Integration Architect is responsible for designing scalable enterprise solutions and seamless integrations between a digital property decisioning platform and banks’ existing technology systems.

The role acts as a technical bridge between customers, Product, Engineering, IT Operations and leadership, ensuring that business requirements are translated into practical, secure, and buildable technical solutions. It involves hands-on API design, troubleshooting, customer engagement, and end-to-end integration delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture

* Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with banking customers.
* Design solution architectures, application components, data flows, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, risks, and dependencies.
* Promote reusable solutions and minimise customer-specific development.

2. API and Integration Design

* Design and document REST APIs, webhooks, callbacks, event-driven integrations, and secure file transfers.
* Develop API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger, including payloads, validation, error handling, versioning, retries, and idempotency.
* Define authentication, authorisation, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Functions, and App Services.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using logs, API traces, and monitoring tools.

3. Requirements Definition

* Work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and customers to gather requirements.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications, API contracts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Support backlog refinement, estimation, prioritisation discussions, and solution feasibility assessments.

4. Customer Integration Delivery

* Act as the primary technical contact for bank integration teams and third-party vendors.
* Coordinate connectivity, certificates, whitelisting, environments, and security approvals.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Ensure integrations are properly documented and handed over to Support and IT Operations.

5. Security and Compliance

* Ensure designs meet banking security requirements and enterprise security standards.
* Address data protection, encryption, data residency, audit logging, and retention requirements.
* Support security assessments and compliance reviews involving RBI guidance, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, and CERT-In requirements.

6. Architecture Standards and Continuous Improvement

* Develop reusable architecture patterns, integration templates, and API standards.
* Improve onboarding efficiency across multiple banking customers.
* Capture implementation lessons and collaborate with global architecture, Product, and Engineering teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Enterprise solution architecture and integration design, preferably in banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, and XML.
* OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS, certificates, and API security.
* Microsoft Azure integration services and API management.
* Event-driven messaging, webhooks, callbacks, batch processing, and SFTP.
* API versioning, retries, timeouts, error handling, and idempotency.
* Experience integrating with loan origination systems, loan management systems, core banking platforms, document management systems, and bank middleware.
* Understanding of banking network security, release governance, SIT, and UAT.
* Experience writing technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

* .NET or Java development experience.
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience working with Indian public sector banks.
* Knowledge of Finacle, TCS BaNCS, Oracle FLEXCUBE, or similar core banking platforms.
* Familiarity with RBI regulations, data protection, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
* TOGAF or other architecture frameworks.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, and integration monitoring tools.

Key Success Metrics

Performance will be measured by:

* Quality and completeness of solution designs and API specifications.
* Clear, testable requirements with minimal engineering rework.
* Successful integration delivery through SIT, UAT, and production go-live.
* Reduction in integration defects and troubleshooting time.
* Reuse of common APIs, templates, and integration patterns.
* Positive feedback from banking technology and security teams.
* Accurate documentation and effective handover to operational teams.
* Reliable technical commitments aligned with platform capabilities.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job

* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures

description:

**Embedded build (50%)**

The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Strategic Builder
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. title: Staff Software Development Engineer L5
description:

The Staff Software Engineer L5 works with all service aspects of high throughput and multi-tenant services, has the ability to design components carefully, properly handle errors, write clean and well-factored code with good tests and good maintainability.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Design distributed systems that are resilient and secure at scale from inception;
* Raise the engineering bar on scale, resiliency, security fundamentals via technical leadership and engineering excellence;
* Discover, review, and influence new and evolving design, architecture, and standards for building and delivering unique services and solutions;
* Investigate, design, and implement best-in-industry, innovative technologies that will expand Inovalon’s infrastructure through robust, scalable, adrenaline-fueled solutions;
* Champion the enterprise infrastructure vision and strategy;
* Be the expert in service reliability and sustainability;
* Develop and execute designs for complex systems backed by excellence, confidence, and thorough engineering analysis;
* Develop, gather, and leverage metrics to manage the server fleet and complex computing systems to drive automation, improvement, and performance;
* Take ownership of ensuring detailed design, analysis, testing, and optimization;
* Set direction/goals for the team regarding project impact, product quality and engineering efficiency;
* Lead major initiatives, projects, teams, rollouts and phased releases;
* Provide mentorship onboarding new team members and enabling successful ramp up;
* Collaborate with other engineers, services across Inovalon, and external customers to understand requirements, have tight feedback loop that is data driven;
* Adhere to all confidentiality, HIPAA, regulatory, and other such policies, procedures, and requirements as outlined within Employer’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the scope of work.
* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement, and fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success.
* On Call Policy: Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical issues, including outside standard business hours (evenings, weekends, and holidays), ensuring timely response and resolution as per defined SLAs.

**Job Requirements**

* Minimum 8+ years’ experience of related professional experience, prior software engineering experience preferred.
* 2+ years’ experience with leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new or existing services/systems
* Excellent programming skills in any object-oriented programming languages - .NET, C#, RESTful API development, EF Core mapping.
* Proficient in Angular, TypeScript etc
* Experience working with SQL, RDS, DynamoDB
* Solid understanding of software & DB design patterns
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design for performance, scalability, and availability.
* Experience working with managed services in Cloud Native AWS, Containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
* Experience working with OAuth2,JWT, Secrets Manager

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2026!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices
* Proactively engage with product leaders and senior management to align technical solutions with overarching business strategies
* Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in data structures, algorithms, and database design
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
* Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations
  
  

* Architectural Leadership: Drive the architectural vision and technical strategy for the data migration engine and its surrounding ecosystem. Contribute core, foundational code that solves the hardest scalability problems and sets the standard for the rest of the team
* Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, and Design to shape the technical roadmap. Anticipate future business needs and translate them into scalable, long-term technical initiatives
* Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Define and champion engineering best practices, patterns, and standards across multiple teams. Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level engineers, cultivating a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

Success Measures
  
  
Within the first three months, you will have:
  
  

* Familiarise yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language
* Familiarise yourself with the problem space and the domain
* Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
* Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews

Within six months, you will have:
  
  

* Worked on and delivered a large-scale code analysis feature in the product
* Contributed to and helped deliver a few releases of the product
* Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered large-scale features across our entire tech stack
* Helped recruit, interview and mentor new members of the team
* Collaborated with other teams at MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

description:
**Meet the Team**
Join a team that's helping some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation. You'll partner closely with customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
You'll work on some of the most challenging AI deployments in the industry, partnering with Fortune 100 organizations to bring cutting-edge AI systems into production. Every engagement influences not only customer success, but also the future direction of the product. If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.

* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.

title: Gen AI Engineer_5+ years
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in developing and deploying LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, and AI agents. The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming skills and experience with modern GenAI frameworks, cloud-based AI services, and production-grade AI applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
  
  
Build RAG pipelines using vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.
  
  
Develop AI agents and multi-agent workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.
  
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, and external data sources.
  
  
Implement prompt engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and hallucination mitigation.
  
  
Develop scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, or Flask.
  
  
Optimize model performance, latency, token usage, and inference costs.
  
  
Deploy and monitor AI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  
  
Collaborate with data engineering, cloud, and product teams to deliver production-ready solutions.
  
  
Mandatory Skills
  
  
Strong Python programming and API development.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
  
  
Practical experience building RAG applications.
  
  
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent frameworks.
  
  
Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and chunking strategies.
  
  
Experience integrating LLMs with enterprise systems and REST APIs.
  
  
Knowledge of LLM evaluation, responsible AI, and production deployment.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI.
  
  
Knowledge of agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  
  
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, or Chroma.
  
  
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud monitoring.
  
  
Experience with GenAI observability, tracing, logging, and cost optimization.

title: Global IT Director
description:
**The role can be based in the WRI Country Office in New Delhi, India. This is a hybrid position. You will need to be in office at least 8 days per month and living within reasonable commuting distance of the office.**
**About The Program**
Global Information Technology enables WRI staff, programs, centers, and international offices to work effectively through secure, reliable, integrated, and user-centered technology services. The team oversees global IT strategy, IT operations, cybersecurity, AI adoption, enterprise platforms, service delivery, governance, data and systems integration, vendor partnerships, and technology risk management. It works across functions and regions to align technology investments and workforce capabilities with WRI’s mission and strategic priorities.
  
  
**Job Highlight**
In this role, you will set WRI’s global technology direction and lead the organization’s IT strategy, IT operations, cybersecurity, AI adoption, enterprise platforms, governance, service delivery, and culture. You will translate organizational priorities into a practical multiyear technology and workforce roadmap while strengthening reliable and accessible services across WRI’s global offices.
  
  
You will be supported by a global IT organization of approximately 34 staff, including managers and technical teams working across regions and enterprise technology areas.
  
  
You will report to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO).
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Global IT Strategy, Governance, and Investment (30%)**

* Develop and execute a global IT strategy and multiyear roadmap aligned with WRI’s mission, operating model, growth plans, and enterprise priorities.
* Advise senior leaders, programs, and functions on technology priorities, investment decisions, standards, platforms, vendors, and major changes.
* Oversee the global technology budget, governance framework, policies, architecture, service levels, decision rights, and escalation paths.
* Define people, service, operational, security, financial, and customer-experience measures and use them to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

**Global Technology Operations, Security, and Resilience (25%)**

* Ensure reliable, secure, and effective connectivity, infrastructure, enterprise applications, collaboration tools, and support services for staff and key partners worldwide.
* Align cybersecurity, privacy, resilience, business continuity, and technology risk management with WRI’s enterprise risk framework and the evolving threat landscape.
* Strengthen integrated data and systems capabilities across functions, programs, centers, and international offices while reducing unnecessary complexity and duplication.
* Promote consistent use of enterprise platforms while keeping services adaptable, resilient, accessible, and responsive across locations and time zones.

**People Leadership and Organizational Capability (25%)**
*Global Team Leadership*

* Lead approximately 34 IT staff across global offices, including managers and teams spanning regions and enterprise technology areas.
* Set clear expectations, strengthen accountability, and empower managers to make timely, well-informed decisions.

*People Development and Leadership Growth*

* Demonstrate a proven record of coaching and developing managers, building high-performing and inclusive teams, addressing performance issues, and retaining talent.
* Show openness to feedback, self-reflection, and continued growth in leadership effectiveness and communication.
* Establish meaningful career paths, succession plans, and leadership pipelines that build organizational capability and prepare future leaders.

*Workforce Planning and Change Leadership*

* Lead workforce planning, organizational design, role clarity, and resource allocation to align talent and capacity with strategic priorities.
* Guide geographically distributed managers and teams through organizational and technology change with clear priorities, communication, training, support, and feedback mechanisms.

**Service Delivery, Business Partnership, and Vendors (20%)**

* Partner with internal stakeholders to evaluate needs, prioritize solutions, improve business processes, and govern changes to technology services and standards.
* Establish and manage strategic provider relationships, including vendor selection, contract negotiation, performance management, and renewal decisions.
* Advance user-centered service delivery and technology adoption through effective communication, training, support, and customer feedback.
* Contribute to WRI management through participation in the Global Leadership Team, strategic planning, and peer review processes.
* Oversee safe and effective operational adoption of AI capabilities across the organization.

**What You Will Need**

* Education: You have a completed bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. An MBA is preferred.
* Experience: You have 15+ years of progressively responsible technology leadership experience, including substantial experience leading managers, global teams, organizational transformation, enterprise strategy, operations, and governance.
* You have experience leading, developing, and retaining geographically distributed teams in a highly matrixed and interdependent organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, performance management, and resource allocation.
* You have deep experience with enterprise technology environments, operating models, architecture, governance, service management, cybersecurity, privacy, resilience, AI adoption, business continuity, and technology risk management.
* You have experience supporting operations in multiple countries and working with vendors, regulatory requirements, including GDPR, and technology standards.
* You have experience with enterprise platforms and capabilities such as human resources, finance, grants and contracts, identity and access management, cloud services, knowledge management, and global connectivity. Experience with Workday ERP is a plus.
* You have experience connecting technology investment, workforce, service, and risk decisions to organizational strategy and measurable outcomes.
* Languages: You have verbal and written proficiency in English.
* Requirements: You will need to have the right to work in and be resident in the WRI Country Office location where you are hired at the start of employment.

**Potential Salary**
**70,00,000 to 80,00,000 INR**
per annum.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Salary is commensurate with experience and other compensable factors.
  
  
Please submit a resume with a cover letter by
**3 November 2026**
. Internal applicants should submit their application through the Jobs Hub portal in Workday. External applicants must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields across Asia, Africa, Europe, Latin America and the US
* The chance to have an impact and to develop your career within a mission driven organization with access to varied learning and training opportunities
* A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work
* The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI
* Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours
* Generous leave days that increase with tenure.

**About Us**
World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyse change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.
  
  
**Our Mission And Values**
WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.
  
  
Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership and Care.
  
  
**Our Culture**
WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.
  
  
Our People team carefully reviews all applications.

The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. * Lead discovery workshops and business capability mapping sessions to define solution constraints, operational goals, and value-based implementation sequences.

* Guide the technical development of repeatable solutions, application modernization frameworks, and artificial intelligence orchestrations while ensuring system diagnostics and compliance with industry standards.
